label: Create table objects
summary: Creates table objects with required columns

precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "objects" (
  "bucket_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "content_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "key" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "size" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("bucket_name", "key"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("bucket_name") REFERENCES "buckets" ("name") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)
